definition: When a model is too simple or undertrained to capture the underlying patterns in the data.
details: Underfitting produces poor performance on both training and validation data, and is typically addressed by increasing model capacity, training longer, or improving feature representations.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. The machine starts out clumsy, makes mistakes, and is nudged a little less wrong every time. It is the same loop you use to learn anything: try, miss, correct, try again. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Underfitting.
